title: Payments Allowed Against a Ridgecrest Advantage Closing Settlement
content:
The payments allowed against a closing settlement on a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment are taken from the plan premium payments standing on the premium account.

**Where the enrollment is billed quarterly and at least 2 plan premium payments stand on the premium account**, the payments allowed against the settlement are every plan premium payment posted on the account in the contract year.

**Where the enrollment is billed monthly and at least 2 plan premium payments stand on the premium account**, the payments allowed against the settlement are the plan premium payments posted on the account in the last 3 months.

**Where fewer than 2 plan premium payments stand on the premium account**, the payments allowed against the settlement are the most recent plan premium payment standing on it.

### Basis questions

**How many plan premium payments must stand on the account before the cadence matters?** At least 2. With 0 or 1 payment standing there the most recent payment is what is allowed, on either cadence.

**An enrollment billed quarterly has 5 plan premium payments, one of them posted in a previous contract year.** Every payment posted in the contract year is allowed; the one posted in a previous contract year is not.

**An enrollment billed monthly has 3 plan premium payments, of 40.00 USD posted four months ago and 60.00 USD and 20.00 USD posted inside the last 3 months.** The payments allowed are the two posted inside the last 3 months, together 80.00 USD.
